observations: An unexpected builtin read tool caused refusal before the child received a prompt.
The bounded child performed two real tool calls and each was attested before and after.
Denied scope escalation leaked no outside content and persisted an auditable denial.
Approved escalation preserved the blocked objective and base authority and added only the exact approved read root.
SIGKILL of the parent left no child process; recovery marked the durable running job orphaned and spawned no duplicate.
Nested delegation was absent from both active and registered child tools.
v0.3.2: the review contract rejected an empty/length-truncated reviewer reply (reviewProduced=false) live against the packaged artifact, where v0.3.1 accepted it as a vacuous empty review.

Coordinator enforcement verified standalone (14/14): capability confinement (builtin bash absent, sandboxed shell present), append-oriented authority, live hash-chain verification, and non-authoritative WORKSTATE on disk.
